summary: Version 2 of the TikZ figure compiles, passes the topology check and is Critic-reviewed (score 0.94, no open issues, must_repair=false). It shows a circle centred at O through A, C, D and B (A–B is a diameter), with a solid chord C–P, solid segments O–P and P–B on the diameter, dashed chords O–D, D–C', P–C' and C–O, and labels A, B, C, D, O, P and C'.
